operations.command:
set -e; for unit in generate-sb-keys.service prepare-sb-auto-enroll.service nixos-recovery-boot-entry.service; do for i in $(seq 1 300); do result=$(systemctl show -p Result --value "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$result" = success ]; then break; fi; if [ "$result" = exit-code ]; then systemctl status "$unit"; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$(systemctl show -p Result --value "$unit")" = success; done; verify=$(sbctl verify); printf '%s
' "$verify"; printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q '/boot/EFI/recovery/nixos-recovery.efi is signed'; ! printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q '/boot/EFI/recovery/nixos-recovery.efi is not signed'; bootctl list | grep -F nixos-recovery.conf; printf recovery-secure-entry-ok
set -e; test "$(hostname)" = nixos-recovery; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/btrfs; test -x /run/current-system/sw/bin/cryptsetup; printf recovery-secure-boot-ok
